terms.gloss: lead back, bring back; escort home
evidence: Cic. Att. 4.6.2: redūcī in carcerem (Lewis & Short)
Quint. 12.8.3: bene comitātī per forum redūcuntur (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: drive back, bring back; bring or reduce (to a state); collect (money)
evidence: Caes. BC 1.76: rem ad prīstinam bellī ratiōnem redēgit (Lewis & Short)

phrases.english: they are escorted home through the forum by a good crowd

phrases.latin: rem ad prīstinam bellī ratiōnem redēgit
phrases.english: he brought the campaign back to the old way of fighting

sources: Lewis & Short: reduco · Lewis & Short: redigo
